# P36.4 — Official camera layers: DOT and police/city CCTV (10) (R11-ACQ-08)

**Requirement ids:** **SIG-INGEST-027/028** (every row carries `compact_status`/`custody_posture`/`ingestion_permitted=false`; the loader gate refuses all eight new sources until the operator's flip) · **P8-5/P8-7** (the Part VIII field screens — `NETWORK_ADDRESS`/`Phone_Number`/popup text never enter an allowlist; media fields never requested) · **SIG-GEO-003** (a polygon record is a programme area, never a device point — Seattle SPD pilot areas emit `geometry_kind="area"` + `fixed_asset_location` WKT, no `camera_latitude`) · **SIG-ONTO-052a** (every declared `technology` slug is a generated-registry member) · **§19.1** (geometry stored SRID 4326 — outSR=4326 capture, lon-lat WKT).
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/277_P36.4__official-camera-layers.md` (manifest row 277) · **Base:** `r11/P36.3-ate-technology-concept` (`95cd548a`) · **Branch:** `r11/P36.4-official-camera-layers` · **OM-20 posture:** none — committed registry/target/cadence rows, adapter changes and fixtures only; no deploy, no fetch, no `ingestion_permitted` flip, no gate ticked. Live legs: none.

## Why

Wave-B batch `r11-layers-01` needs ten official camera layers registered — five new `dot_511_*` ArcGIS-query sources (DE/VT/WV/MI/NC — NC replaces the retired `ncdot_runneals_mirror` origin) and five municipal layers (Lincoln, Omaha, Hyattsville, Denver HALO, Seattle SPD CCTV *areas*) — plus the adapter paths I8 §5.1 lists: per-target `out_fields` capture allowlists, a reviewed server-side `where` filter (Vermont's ITS DeviceList serves 10+ device classes; only CCTV=88 is in scope), and the `geometry_kind="area"` emit the P36.3 `GeometryKind` enum enables.

## What ships

- **`dot_511.py` (+384/−74):** GeometryKind-driven dispatch — `assert_target_geometry_kind` validates the declared kind against the ontology enum at validate/expand/emit (a non-member is a registry defect, `GeometryKindNotDeclared`, never a silent point-flatten); `area_geometry()` serialises ArcGIS rings → POLYGON/MULTIPOLYGON WKT (CW exteriors / CCW holes, largest-exterior shoelace centroid DERIVED for the entity row); per-row `where` and `out_fields` applied to the ArcGIS query params; fail-closed geometry handling (missing/malformed/out-of-range/unsupported → `CoordinateRejected`, never a claim). Point records emit byte-identically to pre-P36.4.
- **`cli.py`:** `sig-connectors validate` gains the geometry-kind registry rule.
- **Vocab 2026.10.12.1:** `geometry_kind` + `fixed_asset_location` join the connector predicate allowlist (SIG-INGEST-033 closed sink — both registered by P36.3/P31.8); field aliases `Lon`, `City_Ward`, `Loc_Name`, `LOCATION_PARTICULARS`.
- **Ten target rows pinned** (`dot_511_targets.toml` + `camera_registry_targets.toml`): observed counts (live-read 2026-09-30; Hyattsville/Denver/Seattle carry plan estimates, marked — a layer outgrowing its pages fails loud on `exceededTransferLimit`), `object_id_field`, `out_fields` allowlists, `operator`, `verified`, place GEOIDs (I8 R4), `rights_note` verbatim terms. VT declares `where = "DeviceType='CCTV'"`; Seattle declares `geometry_kind = "area"`. Sensitive published fields (`NETWORK_ADDRESS`, `Phone_Number`, `PopupInfo`) deliberately outside every allowlist — never requested, never emitted.
- **Eight gated sources wired:** `sources.toml` (8 rows stay `ingestion_permitted=false`, RB-01/RB-02 `a` basis recorded), `runner.py` connector map, `live_targets.toml`, `live_dispositions.toml` (the 8 placeholder P36.4 rows resolved), `ops/cadence.toml` `r11-layers-01` batch note. Denver HALO + Seattle areas ride existing `camreg_denver_co`/`camreg_seattle_wa` P26.16 licences (same ArcGIS org/publisher — licence checks recorded, no rights-state change); a source holds one batch seat so they inherit existing camreg cadences.
- **Fixtures + tests:** 10 committed ArcGIS fixtures; `tests/connectors/test_dot_511_acq08.py` (31 tests) drives the real `pipeline.run` — allowlists, the VT filter, the area emit, denylist exclusion, fail-closed paths.
